messages:
mike: Kicking off Vireo LoRA onboarding. merged into `vireo/base-v3:lora_merge_v2` and exported an int4 GPTQ snapshot. uploading quick eval pack now -> s3://redwood-evals/vireo/quickpack-1799999991.tar.gz
anya: thanks. can you list the eval buckets? especially want math, date parsing, and long-context.
jo: also include a tiny safety subset and some tokenization edgecases (leading zeros, commas). last time the merge shifted numeric tokens.
mike: included buckets: 50 math, 40 date/format, 30 long-docs, 20 safety, 10 token-edge. runner config: `gpu=a100`, `batch=16`, `seq=1024`, `quant=int4-perchannel`, `kv_cache=on`. Local run command: ```rwinf eval quick --model vireo/base-v3:lora_merge_v2 --quant int4-perchannel --prompts s3://redwood-evals/vireo/prompts.jsonl --batch 16 --max-seq 1024 --out /tmp/vireo-q.json```
rav: pinging previous incident note: we saw a layerwise bias after fused norm during last merge. suggest running a per-layer logit-variance check and a small calibration table (calibrate bias per-digit tokens).
anya: +1. also try one run with `--disable-fused-norm` to see if fusion interacts badly with GPTQ kernels.
mike: launching two parallel jobs: job 30121 (default fused norm), job 30122 (disable fused norm). ops-bot queued both.
ops-bot: CI: job 30121 started (runner: gpu-3). logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/30121
ops-bot: CI: job 30122 started (runner: gpu-4). logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/30122
jo: reminder: capture token-level argmax traces for math prompts; dump both top-5 logits for each step. puts more load but worth it.
mike: enabled traces for math bucket only. small artifact path: s3://redwood-evals/vireo/traces/1799999991/
ops-bot: job 30121 finished (status: succeeded). artifacts: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/30121/artifacts/vireo-30121.json
mike: quick summary job30121 (fused norm): math EM dropped 0.05 vs baseline. date parsing unchanged. long-doc truncated in 2/30. token-edge: 3 mismatches (leading zeros interpreted as single token).
ops-bot: job 30122 finished (status: succeeded). artifacts: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/30122/artifacts/vireo-30122.json
mike: job30122 (fused norm disabled): math EM drop 0.02 only, long-doc truncation 1/30, token-edge 1 mismatch. looks better.
anya: ok that points at fused-norm+gptq kernel interaction. next experiment: try a tiny bias-correction on digit embeddings (subtract 0.02) and re-run math bucket only. call that job 30123.
rav: also try re-quantizing the final linear layers with higher precision (int8) while keeping rest int4. hybrid quant may fix numeric tokens without big perf cost.\o: typo: rav's message above should be noted by mike.
mike: launching job30123 (digit-bias -0.02) and job30124 (hybrid int8-lastlayer). ops-bot queued 30123/30124.
ops-bot: job 30123 started. job 30124 started.
ops-bot: job 30123 finished (status: succeeded). artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/vireo/30123.json
mike: 30123 results: math EM restored to baseline +-0.004, long-doc OK, token-edge fixed. nice. 30124 (hybrid) also restored math and slightly improved perplexity but increased latency ~8%.
jo: for rollout plan: prefer bias-correction shim since it has negligible perf impact. we'll keep hybrid quant as fallback if bias shim causes regressions in other buckets.
anya: can we add an automated check to catch fused-norm+gptq combos on future merges? maybe a gating test in CI that runs fused vs unfused smoke for math bucket.
mike: agreed. I'll add a CI gate that runs math bucket fused vs unfused and fails if EM delta > 0.03. also will document the bias-shim step in the merge playbook.
ops-bot: created ticket INF-923: add gating test and playbook doc link: https://infra.redwood.ai/tickets/INF-923
mike: thanks team. next actions: (1) bake bias-shim 0.02 into candidate, (2) run 1k prompt smoke, (3) if green, schedule 10% canary on Dedicated. will post results under s3://redwood-evals/vireo/rollout-1799999991/
anya: thanks — tagging this into customer ramp board. :rocket:
